drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : le carré de sommets $1, i, -1, -i$ dans le plan, les points du réseau $\mathbf{Z}[i]$ marqués, un carré plus petit inscrit, centre $o$
drawings.kind: square lattice: square 1, i, -1, -i with lattice points
drawings.notes: The square with vertices 1, i, -1, -i drawn as a dashed diamond, a horizontal axis from -1 to 1 and a vertical through the centre; inside, a smaller solid square on the lattice lines, lattice points marked, the centre o; parts of an outer frame (pencil). The dashes are schematised. A second similar sketch lower on the page (a diamond inscribed in a dashed square, archive p. 4 at about y 0.66-0.75) is covered by no mark.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : un carré hachuré découpé en quatre, sommets $e$, $\eta'$, $\eta''$, $\eta$
drawings.notes: A square cut in four by its medians, the quarters hatched, vertex labels e (bottom left), eta' (left), eta'' (below), eta (inside, right of centre, as read); around it faint pencil strokes of a larger tilted square.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : l'hexagone de sommets $\pm 1$, $\pm\zeta$, $\pm\bar{\zeta}$, le réseau et ses points marqués
drawings.kind: hexagon of the Eisenstein lattice with marked points
drawings.notes: Hexagon with its three diagonals through the centre and a few lattice lines; six ringed points around the centre (the units +-1, +-zeta, +-zeta-bar) and smaller lattice points; faint pencil lines from the centre up to a point above and an arrow to the right. The labels are not legible on the crop and are left out; lattice lines other than the diagonals are approximate.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis : l'hexagone subdivisé en triangles, un losange de quatre petits triangles repassé en gras. Le « 12 » des arêtes surcharge un autre chiffre. Le reste de la page est blanc ; la suite paginée par lui s'arrête ici, à sa p.~6
drawings.notes: Hexagon with its three diagonals; its upper half is subdivided into small triangles (heavy strokes), the lower half has only the diagonals. The heavy rhombus of four small triangles is approximated by the heaviest strokes; the "12" (overwriting another figure) is not on this crop and is left out.

drawings.description: sous ces deux lignes, deux croquis : un tétraèdre au crayon aux sommets tronqués par de petits cercles ; à droite, un tétraèdre à l'encre dont la subdivision barycentrique est tracée en rouge, avec, en marge :
drawings.kind: two tetrahedra: truncated vertices; barycentric subdivision
drawings.notes: Left: a pencil tetrahedron, its vertices ringed by small circles (truncation), the hidden edge dashed, the shading left out. Right: an ink tetrahedron with its barycentric subdivision (edge midpoints, face centres and the strokes joining them), vertices ringed. The subdivision is red according to the transcription; on the render the colour is hardly distinguishable, so the subdivision is drawn in red after it. The subdivision strokes are approximate.

drawings.description: en haut, une suite de croquis de sphères : à gauche une sphère à équateur avec quatre flèches ; au centre une sphère dont l'équateur porte les points $a, b$ et, au-dessus, $c, d$, d'où partent quatre flèches : vers le haut, marquée $\rho$, deux sphères et un tétraèdre ; vers la gauche, marquée $\sigma$, une sphère méridienne et deux sphères accolées, avec la lettre $\ell$ au-dessous ; vers la droite, deux sphères ; vers le bas, deux sphères et un tétraèdre
drawings.kind: sequence of sphere sketches with arrows
drawings.notes: Left: a sphere with equator and four arrows (up, down, left, right). Centre: a sphere whose equator carries a, b and above it c, d; four arrows: up (rho) to two spheres with meridians and a tetrahedron, left (sigma) to a sphere with a meridian and two spheres side by side, with l below; right to two spheres; down to two spheres and a tetrahedron. The dotted / solid strokes on the small spheres are schematised (equator and meridians), their marked points mostly left out.

drawings.description: sous ces mots, un croquis d'un prisme ou d'une pyramide carrée, au crayon et à l'encre ; puis un petit parallélogramme dont un sommet est marqué, et, à côté :
drawings.kind: sketch of a prism or square pyramid; parallelogram with marked vertex
drawings.notes: Under the words "Carre oriente": a sketch of a pyramid (or prism) on a quadrilateral, pencil and ink, edges approximate; below, a parallelogram whose upper left vertex is a heavy point, with a curved rotation arrow over it. Which solid is meant is not decided by the drawing.

drawings.description: dessin en marge gauche : un graphe à sommets pondérés $0$, $13$, $4$, $2$, $0$, $3$, $1$, avec arêtes multiples, une boucle en $0$ et des arêtes libres ; au-dessous, sous « 2° », un sommet $0$ avec deux arêtes libres, et un sommet $3$ portant une boucle
drawings.kind: graph with weighted vertices, multiple edges, loop and free edges
drawings.notes: Vertices weighted 0, 13, 4, 2, 0, 1: a double edge 0 - 2, a loop at the left 0, double edge 13 - 4, edges 13 - 2, 4 - 2, 4 - 0, 2 - 0, 2 - 1, and free edges; below, under "2 deg" (read 2 with a degree sign), a vertex 0 with two free edges and a vertex 3 carrying a loop. The weight 3 listed by the transcription in the first graph is not found on the crop (only in the second). Not encoded as a stable graph: which strokes are free edges is uncertain.

drawings.description: dessin en marge gauche : des sommets isolés pondérés $g_0$, $g_1$, $g_2$, $g_3$, $g_4$, portant chacun quelques arêtes libres, réunis par une accolade. La parenthèse sous $A$ se lit $\vec{A} \setminus \vec{A}^{\sigma}$ sans certitude
drawings.kind: isolated weighted vertices with free edges, braced
drawings.notes: Vertices g_0, g_1, g_2, g_3, g_4, each with a few free edges (g_1 and g_2 bare points), joined by a brace on the right.

drawings.description: Dessins de la page. À gauche, à l'encre rouge et noire, la sphère à trois trous $0$, $1$, $\infty$ subdivisée : sur le bord du trou $0$ les points $a^0_1, \ldots, a^0_4$ et $b^0_1, \ldots, b^0_5$, sur le trou $1$ les points $a^1_1, a^1_2, a^1_3$ et $b^1_1, \ldots, b^1_4$, sur le cercle extérieur $\infty$ les points $a^\infty_1, a^\infty_2, a^\infty_3$ et $b^\infty_1, \ldots, b^\infty_5$, reliés deux à deux par des arcs. En dessous, des cercles orientés, dont l'un marqué « $[0, \alpha][1, \beta)$ » (lecture douteuse), et deux triangles de sommets $0$, $1$, $\infty$ : le premier avec $\alpha = 3$ (points $a_1, a_2, a_3$ sur le côté $1\infty$), $\beta = 5$ ($b_1, \ldots, b_5$ sur $0\infty$), $\gamma = 4$ ($c_1, \ldots, c_4$ sur $01$) ; le second avec la suite « $c_1 c_2 c_3 c_4 \cdot b_5 b_4 b_3 b_2 b_1$ ». Au centre, un petit triangle subdivisé ($b_1, \ldots, b_5$, $a_1, a_2, a_3$, $c_1, \ldots, c_4$) ; à droite, une carte trivalente et les régions $A_{0\infty}$, $A_{01}$, $A_{10}$, $A_{1\infty}$, $A_{\infty 0}$, $A_{\infty 1}$ au crayon
drawings.kind: page of drawings: subdivided pair of pants, oriented circles, subdivided triangles, trivalent map
drawings.notes: Whole half-page. Left: the sphere with three holes 0, 1, infinity (outer circle), with the points a^0_1..a^0_4, b^0_1..b^0_5 on hole 0, a^1_1..a^1_3, b^1_1.. on hole 1, a^inf_1..a^inf_3, b^inf_1..b^inf_5 on the outer circle, and the arcs joining them (approximate; the hole boundaries drawn red after the transcription, colour faint on the render). Below: oriented circles, one marked [0, alpha][1, beta) (doubtful reading kept), two triangles 0, 1, infinity (alpha = 3, beta = 5, gamma = 4 with a_i, b_i, c_i; the second with c_1c_2c_3c_4 . b_5...b_1), a small subdivided triangle in the centre. Right: a trivalent map (schematised) and the region labels A_{0inf} ... A_{inf1} in pencil; a pencil sphere with three ringed points joined by arcs at the lower right is also drawn (not in the transcription). The text blocks and formulas are left out, and so is a small labelled graph inside the text at the top centre. The labels of hole 1 are partly illegible (b^1_2..b^1_4 placed after the transcription).
drawings.disagreement: The lower right of p. 66 carries a pencil sphere with three ringed points joined by arcs, not mentioned by the transcription.

drawings.description: page de dessin, qui revient au découpage en pantalons des pages 66-69
drawings.kind: triangulated map with nested pants curves; weighted trivalent graph
drawings.notes: Whole half-page. Left: a triangulation with eleven ringed vertices and half-lines going off, surrounded by about ten nested closed curves (the pants decomposition curves, schematised as concentric rings, and only seven drawn); the edges are read approximately. Right: a trivalent graph with weights (1 9, 7, 1, 25, 17 in ink; small figures 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and ringed 1, 2, 3 in pencil), a loop at 17 and free edges, one with an arrow. Caption: "decoupages pantalonesques d'une carte (triangulee)". The small weights are tiny and placed approximately.
